title: Internship programme — Computing and Infocomm Technology
description:
Official internship programme, rather than an individually advertised software-engineer vacancy.

SP Internships offer a holistic experience for students with the desire to join the energy industry.

We offer multidisciplinary internship roles in Computing and Infocomm Technology (Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, Software Development, Information Security, etc.).

Students from Universities, Polytechnics and Institute of Technical Education (ITE) are welcome to join our internship programme.

Send your CV to internship@spgroup.com.sg to apply today!
